'''Baobab Security Directive 51-C''' was a legal restriction set up by [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab's]] [[Baobab HoloNet]]. It successfully restricted the translation of the [[Gonkian/Legends|Gonkian]] phrase "Gonk. Gonk. Gonk ko kyenga see."
